title: An acceptance-evaluation request was refused with 409 'engram work show notes continuation: catalog cut, counts or cursor changed'; one identical request a minute later succeeded, and the cause is unknown
outcome: An evaluation request reads the item's notes from one stable cut: either it succeeds, or it is refused with a cause naming what changed. A note written concurrently, or one still settling, never fails the request with an opaque catalog-cut conflict.
acceptance: An acceptance-evaluation request was refused with 409 'engram work show notes continuation: catalog cut, counts or cursor changed'; one identical request a minute later succeeded, and the cause is unknown is done
